# northflank_addon (Data Source)

Looks up an addon in a Northflank project, either by its `id` or by its `name`, including its connection details. Set exactly one of `id` and `name`.

`secrets` and `connection_details` end up in Terraform state, and are empty while the addon is not running.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "northflank_addon" "db" {
  project_id = "my-application"
  name       = "Main DB"
}

output "db_password" {
  value     = data.northflank_addon.db.secrets["password"]
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) ID of the project the addon belongs to.

### Optional

- `id` (String) Identifier of the addon. Set this to look the addon up by ID.
- `name` (String) Name of the addon. Set this to look the addon up by name, which lists the project's addons to find it.

### Read-Only

- `app_id` (String) Full identifier Northflank uses for the addon.
- `connection_details` (Map of String, Sensitive) Connection details such as hosts, ports and connection strings.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time, in RFC 3339 format.
- `deployment_plan` (String) ID of the compute plan each replica uses.
- `description` (String) Short description of the addon.
- `external_access` (Boolean) Whether the addon is reachable from the internet.
- `region` (String) Region the addon is deployed in.
- `replicas` (Number) Number of replicas.
- `secrets` (Map of String, Sensitive) Secrets for connecting, such as `username` and `password`.
- `status` (String) State of the addon, such as `running`.
- `storage_class` (String) Storage class of the addon.
- `storage_size` (Number) Storage per replica, in megabytes.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags attached to the addon.
- `tls_enabled` (Boolean) Whether connections use TLS.
- `type` (String) Kind of addon, such as `postgresql`.
- `uid` (String) Permanent identifier of the addon. Unlike `id`, it never changes and is never reused.
- `version` (String) Version the addon runs.
- `vpc_accessible` (Boolean) Whether the addon is exposed on the cluster's private load balancer.
